changelog:
llm-provider-whisper-tool-free v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Provides a local Whisper CLI audio-to-text tool supporting common audio format transcription and translation.
- Works fully offline after first-time model download; no API Key required.
- Supports single file transcription, multiple output formats (txt, srt, vtt, json), and lightweight model selection (tiny/base/small).
- Professional features (batch processing, GPU, custom dictionary, speaker separation) not included in this free edition.
- Designed for personal use cases such as meetings, podcasts, and video subtitles.
summary: 本地Whisper CLI语音转文字工具,支持常见音频格式转录与翻译,无需API Key,适合个人使用。
